retrieved.text: The 8 September 2022 notification sets a 75% minimum attendance threshold for end-semester examination eligibility, effective from AY 2022-23 odd semester onward.
The AY 2026-27 calendar lists 30 November 2026 as the last date to apply for attendance condonation. It does not establish who is eligible for condonation.
The SCSET rules specify a minimum four years for B.Tech, and a maximum six years, subject to the document’s provisions.
